title: Look-Back for Tune-Ups Counted Toward the Member Premium Percentage (Repair and Emergency Service Calls)
content:
For the member premium percentage on an after-hours call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls, completed tune-ups are counted from the member's agreement under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements. These are the agreement's tune-up visit entries recorded as completed visits. How far back the count reaches depends on the member's consecutive terms, which count the current term and are held without a break.

**Rule.** The completed tune-ups counted toward the member premium percentage are taken this way:

| Member's consecutive terms | Completed tune-up visits counted |
|---|---|
| At least the third consecutive term | Those posted in the last 24 months |
| The second consecutive term | Those in the last 12 months |
| The first term | Those of the agreement's current term only |

**Visit window.** A visit is within the last 24 or 12 months while fewer than that many whole calendar months have passed from its visit date to the date of handling.

## Questions answered

**A member in the 3rd consecutive term?** Completed tune-ups of the last 24 months.

**A member in the 2nd consecutive term?** Those of the last 12 months, even where older visits from the first term exist.

**A member in the first term?** Only the completed tune-ups of the current term.

## Example (hypothetical record)

A member in the 4th consecutive term has completed tune-up visits 3, 9, 15, 21 and 27 months before the date of handling. Four of them fall within the last 24 months, so 4 tune-ups are counted.
